 Highlights Al-Nasr secured the victory in the second half. 
 The Dean overcomes the disappointment of the President’s Cup 
 Al-Nasr takes sole possession of the top spot in Group B 
 Baghdad, Iraq – Al Nasr returned with a valuable victory from the stadium of its Iraqi host Al Zawraa, after deciding the match with a score of 1-0, in the match that brought the two teams together on Wednesday evening at Al Zawraa Stadium, as part of the second round of the Gulf Champions League for Clubs, so that “Al Ameed” continues its strong start and maintains the lead of Group B with a perfect score.
 Ramon Mirez scored the only goal of the match in the 64th minute, taking advantage of a pass from his teammate Marius Martins, giving the Emirati team three important points away from home, and raising their tally to 6 points from two consecutive victories.

— قنوات الكاس (@AlkassTVSports) October 28, 2026 Al-Nasr secured the victory in the second half.
 The first half ended in a goalless draw, despite both teams’ attempts to score, before Al-Nasr managed to break through Al-Zawraa’s defense during the second half of the match, after Mirez converted one of the opportunities into a goal that gave the visitors the advantage.
 The Iraqi team tried to equalize in the remaining minutes, taking advantage of playing on their home ground and in front of their fans, but Al-Nasr maintained their lead until the final whistle, securing an important victory in their Gulf Championship campaign.
 The Dean overcomes the disappointment of the President’s Cup
 The victory in Baghdad gives Al Nasr a morale boost, after they were eliminated from the Round of 16 of the President’s Cup following their loss to Bani Yas by one goal to nil, after the match went into two extra periods.
 The Emirati team had started its journey in the Gulf Champions League with a resounding victory over Bahrain’s Al-Riffa by three goals to nil at Al Maktoum Stadium in Dubai, with goals scored by Ramon Mirez, Kevin Agudelo and Aiden Hrustic, before adding its second consecutive victory against Al-Zawraa.
 Al-Nasr takes sole possession of the top spot in Group B
 With this result, Al-Nasr raised its tally to 6 points at the top of Group B, continuing its journey under the leadership of its Serbian coach Milos Milojevic, while Al-Zawraa’s tally remained frozen at one point, which it earned from its draw with Qatar SC in the first round.
